body: READ-ONLY ARCHITECTURE CHECKPOINT for bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7. The missing arrow should not literally be SurfaceAtlas -> (NarrativeGraph, NarrativeHierarchy): an atlas contains locators, not enough semantics to determine situations, contexts, identity, relations, or hierarchy. The honest input is SurfaceAtlas + checked local charts + typed proposal/critic evidence + AcceptancePolicy. The existing dependency graph points to document as the pure compiler boundary: it is already the only portable module depending on acquire and story, and it already owns MentionGraph, exact-coreference partitions, and ProjectionIndex; the M1 plan also says document composition/projection under conservative policy. Making acquire depend on story would couple the generic proposal protocol to one ontology and widen embed-core transitively without solving orchestration. Proposed ADR center: keep acquire generic/proposal-only; add a document-owned deterministic NarrativeCompiler whose output is a NarrativeCompilation artifact, not a naked tuple. That artifact should retain MentionGraph, partitions/projections, accepted graph/hierarchy, per-family resolution ledgers, unresolved/alternative outcomes, gate findings, and receipts. Provider execution/cache/retry remains a later JVM orchestrator consuming the pure contract. Order: local charts -> mention graph -> entity/situation identity -> contexts and accepted relation layers -> hierarchy/boundaries -> StoryValidator. A partial build may complete with explicit unresolved outcomes; it may not fabricate precision to satisfy validation. The vertical acceptance test should state both raw inputs explicitly: raw source text plus raw recall transcript reach RecallSignature with no hand-authored source model, while replay from cached provider outputs is byte-identical. Two ADR questions need ruling before code: (1) may a compilation with unresolved required root/context/hierarchy claims emit a typed partial artifact that is not StoryModel[Validated], or must it stop before StoryModel.draft? (2) is NarrativeCompilation the durable scientific artifact, or only an internal precursor to StoryModel plus separate ledgers?
